cliLogin.consent.title: Approve terminal sign-in
cliLogin.consent.lead: The oort CLI in your terminal wants to connect to this workspace with your account.
cliLogin.consent.checkNote: Only allow this if the server address and device name shown in your terminal match the ones below. If they differ, or you did not start this sign-in, deny it.
cliLogin.consent.deviceNote: The device name is chosen by whatever is connecting.
cliLogin.consent.presetHint: Access cannot be changed after you allow it. To change it, connect again.
cliLogin.consent.lifetime: The connection lasts up to {maxDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and ends after {idleDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} without use. Sign-in refreshes automatically every {accessMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Changing your password ends this connection right away.
cliLogin.consent.passwordHint: We ask for your password once more before you allow this.
cliLogin.consent.passwordWrong: That password is not correct. Enter it again.
cliLogin.consent.offlineNote: You are offline. You can allow or deny once you are back online.
cliLogin.consent.rerun: Run oort login again in your terminal.
cliLogin.consent.credentialLimit: Too many devices are signed in with this account. Remove connections you no longer use, then try again.
cliLogin.consent.returning: Your decision is saved. Returning to your terminal.
cliLogin.consent.signinDetail: To review this sign-in request, sign in to this workspace first. You will come back to this request afterward.
cliLogin.preset.readClosed: It cannot send, edit, delete, or change settings.
cliLogin.preset.sendCaution: Messages are sent right away and cannot be edited or deleted. Mentions can wake agents.
cliLogin.preset.sendUnavailable: This sign-in request does not include sending messages, so you cannot choose this.
cliLogin.scope.messagesRead: Read messages and threads in channels
cliLogin.failure.busy: The server is busy for a moment. {wait}
cliLogin.retry.inSeconds: in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
cliLogin.retry.inMinutes: in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
cliLogin.terminal.notFoundHeadline: This request has expired or is not valid.
cliLogin.terminal.notFoundDetail: Nothing was allowed from this page. Run oort login again in your terminal.
cliLogin.terminal.expiredDetail: An expired request cannot be allowed. Run oort login again in your terminal.
cliLogin.terminal.alreadyDecidedDetail: A decision is recorded only once. If you need to, run oort login again in your terminal.
cliLogin.terminal.accessDeniedHeadline: Command-line access cannot be created in this workspace.
cliLogin.terminal.accessDeniedDetail: An admin has to allow it first. Ask a workspace admin if you need it. Nothing was allowed from this page.
cliLogin.terminal.passwordUnavailableHea: This account's password can't be checked.
cliLogin.terminal.passwordUnavailableDet: This account has no password, so it cannot be checked before allowing. You cannot connect the command line this way for now, and nothing was allowed from this page.
cliLogin.terminal.redirectRefusedHeadlin: Couldn't verify the address back to your terminal.
cliLogin.terminal.redirectRefusedDetail: The server's response did not contain a verified address back to this device's terminal (127.0.0.1), so it was not followed. Run oort login again in your terminal.
